text: Figure 1.1: Layered Architecture Ifx routines specification specifies the functionality , API and the configuration of the AUTOSAR library dedicated to interpolation routines for fixed point values. The interpolation library contains the following routines: • Distributed data point search and interpolation • Integrated data point search and interpolation All routines are re-entrant and can be used by multiple applications at the same time.
